==Description==
'''v1.7.0''' is the fifty-first update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 7th of April 2023. It updated UI, made multiple tower rebalances and other smaller changes.

This version encompassed two updates, the main v1.7.0 Update (released 7 April 2023) and the minor v1.7.0a Update (released 8 April 2023).

==Additions==
===Maps===
*[[Unknown Garden]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])

===Miscellaneous===
*[[Stun Immunity]]
*Vertical Upgrade UI
*Prefer Vertical Upgrades setting
*Hide Tower Rings setting
*UI Scale setting
*Enemy highlights
*Unit highlights

==Changes & Bugfixes==

**Shells will now land behind enemies.

*[[Accelerator]]'s tower ring no longer becomes purple at Level 5.
*[[Engineer]]'s ''Scrap Meter'' is now visible when you hover your cursor over it.
*Fixed the Level 5 [[Mortar]] using a regular explosion instead of the nuclear explosion.
*Fixed the {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Commander]] skin animations and cosmetics not working properly.
*[[Archer]] is now obtainable through a gamepass for {{Robux|500}}.
*[[Turret]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|800}} to {{Robux|600}}.
*[[Mortar]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|700}} to {{Robux|500}}.

*[[Cowboy]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|450}} to {{Robux|250}}.
*[[Warden]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|800}} to {{Robux|480}}.

===Enemies===
*[[Stun Immunity]] added to the [[Amalgamation]], [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] from the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier, [[Super Toxic]], [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]], [[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]], [[Nuclear Monster]] and [[Gunslinger]].

:In '''v1.7.0a''':
*Fixed [[Wox the Fox]] not being able to use its abilities.
*Fixed [[Wox the Fox]]'s jumpscare from the ''Game Over'' ability not appearing.

===Maps===
*[[Dead Ahead]] changed.
**[[Dead Ahead]] remade.
**[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added.

===Crates===
*[[Cold Front Crate]] skins are no longer guaranteed to appear in the [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|Daily Store]].

===Miscellaneous===
*New upgrade UI.
**Tower icons in upgrade boxes are now viewports of the Default skin instead of an image.
*New range rings for the regular attack range, sentry placement range, deadzone range and circling range.
*New tower rings.
*New boss health bar UI.
*New [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], [[Flying]], [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] and [[Defense]] icons.
*New UI for when you hover over/select a tower, enemy and unit.
*Updated attribute tags.
**[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|HiddenDetectionOld2.png|HDN}} to {{AttrTag|Second|HiddenDetection.png|Hidden}}.
**[[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|DefenseOld.png|LEAD}} to {{AttrTag|Second|LeadIcon.png|Lead}}.
**[[Flying]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|FlyOld.png|FLY}} to {{AttrTag|Second|Fly.png|Flying}}.
**[[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|GhostImmunity.png|GHST}} to {{AttrTag|Second|GhostImmunity.png|Ghost}}.
**[[Freeze Immunity]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|Freeze.png|ICE}} to {{AttrTag|Second|Freeze.png|No Freeze}}.
**[[Energy Immunity]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|Energy.png|ENGY}} to {{AttrTag|Second|Energy.png|No Energy}}.
**[[Splash Damage Immunity]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|Explosion.png|EXP}} to {{AttrTag|Second|Explosion.png|No Explosion}}.
**[[Burn Immunity]] tag changed from {{AttrTag|First|Fire.png|BRN}} to {{AttrTag|Second|Fire.png|No Burn}}.
**[[Boss]]es now have a {{AttrTag|Second|BossIcon.png|Boss}} tag under their health.
*All stats in upgrade boxes now change when the tower is affected by buffs, including upgrade descriptions.
*You can now select towers of other players.
*You can now go back and forward when selecting a targeting option.
*Names of some targeting options changed.
*Units now display that they have hidden detection under their health.
*Show Vertical Upgrades setting now works as vertical upgrade UI has been added.
*Fixed issues where tower placed counter listed an incorrect amount of towers. It would list a higher or lower amount of towers placed than there actually were.
*Fixed enemy hitboxes preventing players from selecting towers.
*Fixed circling range not being displayed properly.
*Fixed custom [[DJ Booth]] music gamepass in the Gamepasses section of the store selling the VIP gamepass.
*Fixed unit spawners not appearing in upgrade boxes on mobile.
*Fixed lead detection and flying detection stats not appearing in upgrade boxes on mobile.
*VIP gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|400}} to {{Robux|300}}.
